def criticalConnections(V, adj):
    def dfs(node, parent, low, disc, time, stack, visited, bridges):
        nonlocal timer
        visited[node] = True
        low[node] = disc[node] = timer
        timer += 1
        children = 0
        
        for neighbor in adj[node]:
            if not visited[neighbor]:
                children += 1
                stack.append((node, neighbor))
                dfs(neighbor, node, low, disc, time, stack, visited, bridges)
                low[node] = min(low[node], low[neighbor])
                
                if (parent == -1 and children > 1) or (parent != -1 and low[neighbor] > disc[node]):
                    bridges.append(sorted((node, neighbor)))
            elif neighbor != parent:
                low[node] = min(low[node], disc[neighbor])
        
        while stack and stack[-1][0] == node:
            bridges.append(sorted(stack.pop()))
    
    timer = 0
    low = [float('inf')] * V
    disc = [float('inf')] * V
    visited = [False] * V
    bridges = []
    stack = []
    
    for i in range(V):
        if not visited[i]:
            dfs(i, -1, low, disc, timer, stack, visited, bridges)
    
    return bridges
